'''Charles James Elleby''' (born June 16, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Hapoel Be'er Sheva B.C.|Hapoel Be'er Sheva]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State Cougars]], and was drafted in the 2nd round of the [[2020 NBA Draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].

==Early life==
Elleby was born in [[Federal Way, Washington]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-23 |title=CJ Elleby, Minnesota Timberwolves, SF - News, Stats, Bio |url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/players/3042444/cj-elleby/ |access-date=2025-06-23 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Oregonian/OregonLive |first=Aaron Fentress {{!}} The |date=2020-11-26 |title=Trail Blazers draft pick CJ Elleby propelled by family of Seattle basketball legends to NBA |url=https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2020/11/trail-blazers-draft-pick-cj-elleby-propelled-by-family-of-seattle-basketball-legends-to-nba.html |access-date=2025-06-23 |website=oregonlive |language=en}}</ref> He attended [[Cleveland High School (Seattle)|Cleveland High School]] in [[Seattle]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/812655/2019/02/12/meet-cj-elleby-the-no-star-prospect-having-one-of-best-freshman-seasons-in-washington-state-history/|title=Meet CJ Elleby, the unheralded prospect having one of the best freshman seasons in Washington State history|first=Vince|last=Grippi|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=February 12, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> As a sophomore, Elleby averaged 16 points and 10 rebounds and helped lead Cleveland to the state playoffs. He averaged 23.0 points, 13.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists per game and was named second-team All-[[Metro League (Seattle)|Metro League]] in his junior season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2017/nov/13/washington-state-inks-seattle-forward-charles-elle/|title=Washington State inks Seattle forward Charles Elleby to letter of intent|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=November 13, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> Elleby averaged 23.5 points per game as a senior and was named first-team All-Metro and first-team All-State by the [[Associated Press]] and ''[[The News Tribune]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dailyevergreen.com/44819/sports/td-athlete-of-the-week/|title=Athlete of the Week: CJ Elleby|first=Shawn|last=O'Connor|work=[[The Daily Evergreen]]|date=January 8, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> Elleby committed to play college basketball at [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]] early in his senior year over offers from [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]] and [[Seattle Redhawks men's basketball|Seattle]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/high-school/clevelands-cj-elleby-commits-to-washington-state-for-basketball/|title=Cleveland's CJ Elleby commits to Washington State for basketball|first=Nathan|last=Joyce|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=September 9, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/washington-state/Article/CFC-talks-to-future-Coug-Elleby-and-his-dad-a-longtime-fixture-on-Seattle-prep-basketball-scene-107382434/|title=Hoops: What made Seattle's CJ Elleby choose crimson over purple?|first=Barry|last=Bolton|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=September 13, 2017|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref>

==College career==
Elleby averaged 14.7 points and 7.1 rebounds per game as a true freshman and was named to the [[Pac-12 Conference]]'s All-Freshman team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2019/10/24/return-of-cj-elleby-good-news-for-washington-state-hoops/40413571/|title=Return of CJ Elleby good news for Washington State hoops|first=Nicholas|last=Geranios|work=[[USA Today]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=October 24, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/washington-state/Article/Washington-State-basketball-Robert-Franks-CJ-Elleby-Cougs-Cougars-Wazzu--129957088/|title=WSU hoops: Franks first-team All-Pac-12; Elleby All-Freshman|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=March 11, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> He scored a season high 26 points against [[Washington–Washington State men's basketball rivalry|rival]] [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2019/feb/15/cj-elleby-has-been-a-rare-rookie-for-washington-st/|title=CJ Elleby has been a rare rookie for Washington State, and the Cougars are reaping the full benefits of his skills|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=February 15, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> In wake of the firing of WSU head coach [[Ernie Kent]], Elleby initially declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent and ultimately decided to return to Washington State for his sophomore season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2019/mar/29/washington-state-freshman-cj-elleby-declares-for-n/|title=Washington State freshman CJ Elleby declares for NBA draft, won't hire agent immediately|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=March 29, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/wsu-cougar-basketball/cleveland-high-product-cj-elleby-withdraws-from-nba-draft-and-will-return-to-wsu/|title=Cleveland High product CJ Elleby withdraws from NBA draft and will return to WSU|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=May 28, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://lmtribune.com/sports/stock-for-elleby-cougs-clearly-on-the-rise/article_646ffda5-42bf-54a4-8629-03a02a3f820a.html|title=Stock for Elleby, Cougs clearly on the rise|first=Colton|last=Clark|work=[[Lewiston Morning Tribune]]|date=February 1, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref>

Elleby entered his sophomore season as a preseason first team All-Pac-12 selection and was named to the [[Julius Erving Award|Julius Erving]] and [[John R. Wooden Award|Wooden Award]] watchlists.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-basketball/uws-jaden-mcdaniels-wsu-cj-elleby-chosen-to-preseason-watch-list/|title=UW's Jaden McDaniels, WSU CJ Elleby chosen to preseason watch list|work=[[The Seattle Times]]|date=October 16, 2019|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> Elleby was named the Pac-12 Player of the Week on January 20, 2020, after scoring 25 points with a career-high 14 rebounds in 72–61 victory against eighth-ranked [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] and scoring 22 points with nine rebounds and five assists in a 89–76 win over [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cougcenter.com/2020/1/21/21074767/hca-cj-elleby-pac-12-wsu-cougars-basketball|title=HCA: CJ Elleby named Pac-12 Player of the Week|first=Nick|last=Nordi|website=CougCenter.com|date=January 21, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> Elleby scored a career-high 27 points with 12 rebounds and hit a go-ahead three-pointer with four seconds left to beat Arizona State 67–65.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://collegebasketball.ap.org/article/ellebys-3-leads-washington-st-victory-over-arizona-st|title=Elleby's 3 Leads Washington St. To Victory Over Arizona St.|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=January 30, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}}</ref> Elleby set a new career high with 34 points while also grabbing 10 rebounds on February 9, 2020, in a 79–67 win over Washington.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thenewstribune.com/sports/college/university-of-washington/article239922243.html|title=UW Huskies drop sixth straight as CJ Elleby leads Washington State to 79–67 win|first=Lauren|last=Kirschman|work=[[The News Tribune]]|date=February 9, 2020|access-date=February 10, 2020}}</ref> Elleby became the third-fastest player in Cougars' history to score 1,000 career points during a 21-point performance in a 78–74 win over Washington to complete a regular season sweep of the Huskies.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2020/feb/28/washington-state-cj-elleby-joins-1000-point-club-i/|title=Washington State's CJ Elleby joins 1,000-point club in return to Seattle|first=Theo|last=Lawson|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=February 28, 2020|access-date=February 29, 2020}}</ref> At the conclusion of the regular season, Elleby was named to the First Team All-Pac-12.<ref name="Pac-12 Awards">{{Cite web|url=https://pac-12.com/article/2020/03/08/2019-20-pac-12-mens-basketball-all-conference-awards-announced|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200326010600/https://pac-12.com/article/2020/03/08/2019-20-pac-12-mens-basketball-all-conference-awards-announced|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 26, 2020|title=Pac-12 announces 2019-20 Men's Basketball annual major awards|date=March 9, 2020|website=pac-12.com|access-date=March 9, 2020}}</ref> As a sophomore, Elleby averaged 18.4 points and 7.8 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite news |title=Washington St. faces ASU in Pac-12 quarters |url=https://apnews.com/83f7d424521e47b48640146c4cddf478 |access-date=April 12, 2020 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 12, 2020}}</ref> Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Washington State's CJ Elleby to test NBA draft waters again |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29072203/washington-state-cj-elleby-test-nba-draft-waters-again |access-date=April 30, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=April 20, 2020}}</ref> On July 31, Elleby announced he was remaining in the draft, forgoing two seasons of college eligibility.<ref>{{cite news |title=Washington State's CJ Elleby to keep name in NBA draft, won't return for junior season |url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/wsu-cougar-basketball/washington-states-cj-elleby-to-keep-name-in-nba-draft-wont-return-for-junior-season/ |access-date=August 2, 2020 |work=[[Seattle Times]] |date=July 31, 2020}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Portland Trail Blazers (2020–2022)===
Elleby was selected with the 46th pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2020/11/portland-trail-blazers-selected-washington-state-forward-cj-elleby-with-46th-pick-nba-draft.html|title=Portland Trail Blazers select Washington State's CJ Elleby with 46th pick in NBA draft|first=Aaron|last=Fentress|work=[[The Oregonian]]|date=November 18, 2020|access-date=November 19, 2020}}</ref> On November 22, he signed a two-year contract and announced that he would wear the number 16 with Portland.<ref>{{cite news |title=Trail Blazers Sign CJ Elleby |url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/2020/11/22/blazers-sign-cj-elleby |work=Portland Trail Blazers |agency=NBA.com |language=en}}</ref>

===Iowa Wolves (2022–2023)===
On August 23, 2022, Elleby signed with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Timberwolves Sign CJ Elleby and Luka Garza |url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-cj-elleby-and-luka-garza |access-date=2022-08-24 |website=NBA.com |language=en}}</ref> He was then later waived on October 15, 2022. On November 2, 2022, Elleby was named to the opening night roster for the [[Iowa Wolves]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/iowa-wolves-finalize-opening-night-roster/n-5895237|title=Iowa Wolves Finalize Opening Night Roster|website=oursportscentral.com|date=November 2, 2022|access-date=November 2, 2022}}</ref> He was waived on February 2, 2023.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions?teams=All+Teams | title=NBA G League Transactions }}</ref>

===Salt Lake City Stars (2023)===
On February 20, 2023, Elleby was acquired by the [[Salt Lake City Stars]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|date=February 20, 2023|access-date=February 20, 2023}}</ref>

===Bnei Herzliya (2023)===
On April 19, 2023, Elleby signed with [[Bnei Herzliya Basket|Bnei Herzliya]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=סי.גיי אלבי מצטרף|url=https://www.bhbasket.co.il/news?NewsId=15120|website=BHBasket.com.il|date=April 19, 2023|access-date=June 9, 2023|language=Hebrew}}</ref>

===Greensboro Swarm (2023)===
On October 30, 2023, Elleby rejoined the [[Salt Lake City Stars]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Stars Announce 2023-24 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/stars-announce-2023-24-training-camp-roster/n-6027250|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=January 26, 2024}}</ref> but was waived on November 9.<ref>{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Salt Lake City Stars Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Salt-Lake-City-Stars/42/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=January 26, 2024}}</ref> Thirteen days later, he signed with the [[Greensboro Swarm]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Swarm Announce Multiple Transactions|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/swarm-announce-multiple-transactions|website=NBA.com|date=November 22, 2023|access-date=November 26, 2023}}</ref> but was waived on December 11.<ref>{{cite web|title=Swarm Complete Multiple Transactions|url=https://greensboro.gleague.nba.com/news/swarm-complete-multiple-transactions|website=NBA.com|date=December 11, 2023|access-date=December 11, 2023}}</ref>

===Mexico City Capitanes (2024)===
On March 27, 2024, Elleby joined the [[Mexico City Capitanes]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=CAPITANES|title=Comunicado oficial: Capitanes anuncia la incorporación de C.J. Elleby, quien se incorpora al equipo para cerrar la temporada 2023-24 de la NBA G League. #SomosCapitanes|number=1773107261323297149|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=March 27, 2024|access-date=March 28, 2024|language=Spanish}}</ref>

===MKE Ankaragücü (2024–present)===
On July 14, 2024, Elleby signed with MKE Ankaragücü of the [[Türkiye Basketbol Ligi]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=MKE Ankaragücü Basketbol Kulübü|title=🖋️ CJ Elleby MKE Ankaragücü IKON Menkul'de! Portland Trail Blazers'ın 2020 yılında draft ettiği, 88 kez NBA'de forma giyen CJ Elleby yeni sezonda sarı lacivertli formamızı giyecek. Hoş Geldin CJ Elleby 💛💙|number=1812510347120763322|user=MKEAnkaragucuBK|date=July 14, 2024|access-date=July 16, 2024|language=Turkish}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Elleby's father, Bill Elleby, played basketball collegiately at [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]] and runs Seattle Basketball Services, a collegiate scouting service. Elleby has four siblings.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/high-school/clevelands-c-j-elleby-is-latest-in-his-family-to-make-mark-on-seattle-basketball-scene/|title=Cleveland's C.J.
